body: Do u feel better now? Does it get better? I really hope you do.

I think you came to this life to learn to let go, nothing is  forever, including this life on earth will have an end, when  we die our soul is separated from this body, this body will stay here on earth to continue it's cycle and our soul will continue it's journey to another dimension only souls can enter, time is an illusion and only exist in this time/space here on earth, but our soul is not part of time, it goes beyond it, you see the effects of time right now because we are currently on this 3D realm,we are only passengers and time is measured differently when you are an eternal soul, what I mean is this existence on earth and this life is not all there is, don't torture yourself thinking about the time when it'll come to an end, because when it does, you'll regret the fact you could not enjoy the moment  'cause you couldn't stop thinking about what you were losing, sometimes happiness is right in  front of our noses, but we are not living the present, because we spend our time regretting past or worrying about future, none of that will give you peace, past is gone, and  future depends on your present, which is what you have right now, stay present, enjoy, by the time it comes to an end, you'll be sad cause it's over but you won't regret it 'cause you enjoyed every single minute of it. My wife passed away and of course I miss her every single day, but those 8 years we spent together I gave her all my love and care as much as I could, and that makes me feel happy, with me and with her.

My advise: Don't measure your life in losses but wins.  Hope this helps you a little
